w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: The landlord is stamping the ground. Each stamp lands like a gavel. The tiles it marks start to feel wrong under your feet.

w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: The Spool stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — Chorus Line.

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Terms of Service is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ THE CALLBACK! You're on your own.

w3Mentions.name: Buffering
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Buffering is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (tick, Ad Break, The Big Beast, Ugly-Eyes) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! No walls. No warning but the noise.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📖 Codex: Rerun — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.
firstContext: 📖 Codex: Rerun — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: ◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT."
◈ ABILITY — Dreadfield: The room feels you before you speak. Alien-terror starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ ABILITY — Oathbound: Your terror is pledged as a shield: your own people's horror grows half as fast.
◈ ABILITY — Shieldbearer: Spend terror to calm horror — the shield, not the sword. (Offered in the final beat.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 🚶 Zoltan Nagy walks in — pack light, eyes wide. Haven grows by one. (9 souls.)
A frightened family waits a while, then moves on down the road. Word travels about that, too.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
📺 SYSTEM: "CONTEST: The Quiet Room. One silent hour in a white room. The System reads your thoughts aloud to the village. You cannot argue with the broadcast — you can only steer what surfaces."

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (20/8/7), with 4 wave-4 fought, 6 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 3 · Forage 4 · Craft 8 · Talk 14 · Explore 32 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; the relay carried faithfully. The light road is open.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

firenarr.line: ⚠ The store keeps slipping from its recent high — evening after evening, lower.
⚠ The store has fallen further still from its recent high.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,073 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
It wants the job itself: caretaking, as a practice. This is the ask the whole ladder was climbing toward.
